title: Steam Achievement Completion by Franchise
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steam:activity
| search achievement_pct=*
| stats avg(achievement_pct) as achievement_pct sum(playtime_min) as playtime_min by franchise
| sort 0 - achievement_pct
value: Franchise completion helps show where you are actually finishing games instead of just sampling them.
implementation: Send achievement completion events to `index=personal` and keep `franchise` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of achievement completion by franchises.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which franchisess stand out most for achievement completion.
